component.name: EL-FETCH
component.summary: Find the cheapest electronic parts including shipping

description.p: Type a part and EL-FETCH asks many electronics shops at once, then ranks every offer by item price plus shipping to your country.

ul.li: Geizhals, Reichelt, Berrybase, Pollin, Amazon and AliExpress without any setup
Mouser, DigiKey, Farnell, eBay and Octopart with a free API key
Live shipping costs where the shop provides them, estimates otherwise
Quantity price breaks and multi-packs are taken into account
Results stream in as each shop answers; double-click an offer to open it

description.p: Supported countries: Austria, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, the Netherlands, France, Poland and the United Kingdom. The same app works from a terminal: flatpak run io.github.a7knsh.EL_FETCH search 1N4007

screenshot.caption: Offers for a Raspberry Pi 5, sorted by total price

description.p: Flatpak bundle attached to each GitHub release.
